utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Cleo, I’m still catching up, but the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. I’m helping with setup and checking who has tools or can cover sign-ups—do you know what you’re able to help with?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Dane—Sunday at the community center helps a lot. I can handle the supply list and check who can bring tools, patch materials, batteries, and anything for porch steps or leaky gutters.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’s perfect, Cleo—thank you. I’ll pass along that you’re covering the supply list, and I’ll keep checking on sign-up help and setup needs for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Uli—I'm still pinning down the repair drive layout, but Leo has the community shed intake table Saturday morning with labels and basic tools. Could you tell me what tools or station you can cover so I can place you without overlap?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Opal. I can probably cover a quiet labeling or list-checking spot for a short stretch, but I can’t promise heavy tools or a full station right now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That helps, Uli—I'll put you down for a short list-checking slot near Leo's community shed intake table, not a heavy-tool station. Once Mara confirms the exact drop-off timing, I'll pin your stretch to it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Nell, I’ve got Ira at maybe six volunteers and I’m waiting on Eli for the real sign-up sheet; have you heard whether Cleo or Opal has the repair priority list?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard that directly yet, but I’ve been asking around and can check with Cleo and Opal next. If Eli sends you the sign-up sheet, I’ll help match it against whatever priority list turns up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—ask Cleo and Opal for the priority list and drop-off details, and I’ll chase Eli for the actual sign-up sheet so we’re not working off maybes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday morning at the community shed is still the plan. Bring any busted small appliances or spare tools, and I’ll help sort them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh good, thanks Leo—I’d heard something about Sunday at the community center from Sam, so I’m glad to double-check. Do we have an exact start time yet?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ve been telling folks Saturday morning, but I don’t have a firm hour yet. I’ll check with Rosa and send the exact start time around.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Tess, I’m still hearing the details are being pinned down—Saturday morning has a collection table, but the exact drop-off spot and volunteer count aren’t firm yet.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Ira — I’ll pass along that Saturday morning is only tentative for now, and tell folks to hold off hauling anything over until the spot and volunteer numbers are firm.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds right, Tess—Quinn said Mara’s pinning down the drop-off windows and spot, so I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the firm details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Gus, quick version—I’m already on sign-in Friday 3:15 to 4, and for Saturday I can only help later in the day.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Bo—that helps. I’m bringing the screwdrivers, pliers, socket set, extension cord, and work light Saturday morning, so if you hear what’s still needed later, just point me that way.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, Gus—tools covered Saturday morning. If I hear where the later-day gap is, I’ll point you there or jump in myself.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh Rey, I think folks are starting with porch steps and leaky gutters first. Vik’s the one keeping me straight on the timing, so he may know where the list’s got to.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren—that helps. I’ll check with Vik on the timing and keep pointing folks to Rosa for sign-ups and supply needs.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’s it, Rosa for the sign-ups—thank you, Rey. I’ll keep that in my head if it doesn’t wander off before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye—I’ve got you down for 2:30 to 3:15, which is a big help around pickup time. I’m finishing the sign-up sheet today and will send you the details once the drop-off windows are set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Mara — 2:30 to 3:15 works for me. Once you send the sign-up sheet, I’ll help point folks to the right drop-off window before pickup gets busy.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s perfect, Faye—thank you. I’ll mark you for guiding drop-offs from 2:30 to 3:15 and send the sheet as soon as I’ve got the windows pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Rosa, I’m glad Leo confirmed Saturday morning at the community shed, but do we have an exact start time before people start hauling appliances over?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking, Pia—there’s been a change: the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the shed. Let’s tell folks to bring items starting at 9 a.m. so we can set up calmly.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, good thing we checked—Sunday at the community center starting at 9 a.m. is much clearer. I’ll make sure I repeat that exactly so no one drags appliances to the shed Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, I’m linking up the different crews for Opal’s repair drive—what can your group cover, and do you already have tools planned so we don’t overlap with Mara’s folks?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: We can cover intake and a basic fix-it table, and I’m tracking tools now—mostly screwdrivers, pliers, extension cords, and a couple sewing kits. If Mara’s folks already have power tools or bike gear handled, we’ll steer clear and fill gaps.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks Sam—I’ll put your crew down for intake plus the basic fix-it table, with hand tools and sewing kits. Mara’s side has Leo and Faye on intake and Gus waiting on Opal’s tool list, so I’ll compare notes and nudge you if bike gear or power tools still need covering.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Kira, the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and I’m posting the sign-up sheet at the library with repair categories this afternoon. Once that’s up, I’ll give Gus the exact tool list so drop-offs stay sorted.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sunday, not Saturday—can you confirm that’s the final date, Eli? And once the sheet’s up, send me the categories so I don’t assign anyone wrong.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Sunday is the final date at the community center. I’ll send you the repair categories right after I post the library sheet this afternoon, so assignments stay clean.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hi Hana! I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—Mara’s still finalizing the drop-off windows and spot, but can I count on you to invite a couple neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can help, Quinn, but I’d rather not invite folks until Mara confirms the drop-off window and spot. Once those are firm, I can reach out to a couple neighbors right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Hana—thanks for being ready. I’ll circle back with the confirmed window and spot as soon as Mara pins them down, then you can invite folks right away.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Sam, I’m glad to help with the repair drive, but I’m still waiting on the confirmed Saturday start time, drop-off window, and which role needs volunteers most.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Hana—I’ll check with Rosa on the confirmed time and drop-off window, though I’ve heard it may be Sunday at the community center now. Once I confirm, I’ll let you know where volunteers are needed most.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam—please do confirm whether it’s Saturday at the shed or Sunday at the community center before I tell anyone where to go. Once you hear from Rosa, I can help match volunteers to the biggest gap.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Faye, are you still good for 2:30 to 3:15, and what repair station can I put you down for?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I can do 2:30 to 3:15 before school pickup; please put me where sign-up help is most needed unless Mara confirms a specific repair station.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, I’ll mark you for 2:30 to 3:15 on sign-up help unless Mara assigns you a station. Can you bring a clipboard or pens, or should I track those down?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ve only heard to keep it simple for now: Saturday morning at the community shed, but folks should wait until Quinn confirms the exact time before bringing anything over.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Uli—I may be mixed up then, because Sam told me it moved to Sunday at the community center. I’ll hold off spreading anything else until Quinn confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah—that may be newer than what I heard, but I’d rather not muddy it. Let’s both wait for Quinn’s confirmed word before passing anything along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Oren—yes, I’ve still got you down for porch steps once we confirm the start time. I’m checking the final details today and I’ll make sure you get a clear reminder.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo—that’s a relief. If you hear where hands or tools are shortest, remind me of that too, because you know I’ll forget unless someone says it twice.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely, Oren—I’ll remind you twice if I have to. Once I hear where hands or tools are shortest, I’ll point you straight to the right job.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hi Jules! I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—Mara’s still finalizing the drop-off time and spot, but can I count on you to invite a couple neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, Quinn — I’ve already been checking in with a few groups, so I’ll invite a couple more neighbors and send anything I hear back toward Opal and Tess.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s perfect, Jules—thank you! I’ll pass along the final time and drop-off spot as soon as Mara confirms them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Dane, I’m still waiting on a firm drop-off window for the repair drive, so please tell folks not to bring anything over just yet.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, Tess — I’ll tell folks to hold off on drop-offs for now. I’m still catching up, but I’ll keep pointing them to Sunday at the community center unless you send a firmer window.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Dane — yes, Sunday at the community center is the place, but please stress that the drop-off window isn’t firm yet. I’ll pass the exact time along as soon as Mara or the others confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Leo, before everyone starts hauling appliances over, can you confirm the exact drop-off time Saturday and any setup instructions for the shed?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Not confirmed yet, Pia—I’m waiting on Cleo or Quinn for the exact start time. For now, tell folks not to bring anything over until I send the final time and shed setup note.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo—I’ll tell folks to hold off until your final time and shed setup note comes through. Please send it as soon as Cleo or Quinn confirms, so nobody ends up waiting with appliances.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Rey—Mara’s still finalizing the drop-off spot, but I’m mapping tool and station assignments now; can you let me know what you’re able to bring or cover?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring a basic hand-tool kit and help cover the sign-up or supply-check table, Opal—just tell me where Rosa and Mara want me once the spot’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Rey—I’ll mark you down for a hand-tool kit and as flexible for sign-up or supply-check, then I’ll place you once Mara confirms the drop-off spot and Rosa’s table layout.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Vik, I’m still piecing the repair drive together from everyone’s updates—have you heard whether there’s one shared list yet, or if cords and a work light are still needed?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I haven’t seen one firm shared list yet, Nell—Tess also said not to have folks haul anything over until the drop-off window is confirmed, so I’m waiting on Cleo before I repeat needs like cords or a work light.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik—that matches the scattered picture I’m getting. I’ll hold off on telling Gus to bring extras and keep an ear out for Cleo’s confirmed drop-off window.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli, I’m glad we could connect—the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’d love your help keeping volunteers clear on the updated time and location.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rosa—I’ll update the sign-up sheet at the library with Sunday at the community center and the repair categories. Then I’ll let Mina and Gus know what’s firm so we’re not working from maybes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Eli—that’ll help a lot. Please mark Sunday at the community center as firm, and note that I’m still confirming final supply needs before we ask folks to bring extras.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, I’m still waiting on the confirmed time and drop-off spot, but I’ve heard folks are collecting broken small appliances and bikes, plus supplies for porch steps, leaky gutters, tools, patch materials, and batteries.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Ira—can you confirm whether you’re able to help once the time and drop-off spot are set, and if Saturday morning would work for you?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, Saturday morning should work for me once the time and drop-off spot are confirmed, and I can invite a couple neighbors while I’m out.
